shared_elements: stacked/registered composition with figures placed one above another
animal heads with prominent eye rendered in relief
justification: Both are stone low reliefs organised as superimposed tiers of profile animal figures, with prominent horned animal heads occupying a lower zone in each. Beyond that generic correspondence the execution is wholly different: A is coarse, schematic and shallowly pecked on a rough weathered block, whereas B is a smooth, finely modelled and richly textured relief dominated by a naturalistic bearded human head that has no counterpart in A.
